name: Kunoichi no Ubaikata ~Gakuen no Nazo~
original_name: くノ一の奪い方 ～学園の謎～
source:
Our protagonist Sasuke is one of Shinobi tribe which has survived with fewer members.
One day, he is informed that his senior mate disappeared on a mission. 
In search of the mate, he sneaks into an academy of female ninjas...

There, he will go through a course of battle f*ck sessions with beautiful aspiring female ninjas!
